menu:3143020:1.text: Spar, cards, or placing bets? You're welcome anytime!
menu:3143020:1.source_cn: 比武、打牌还是押注？随时欢迎！

say:1:1123608001:1.text: Lately, many have lost their belongings at the Sunseek Arena. I suspect there's a thief, and I'd like you to look into it.
say:1:1123608001:1.source_cn: 最近有很多人在残阳武斗场丢了东西，我怀疑有人偷窃，想请...
say:1:1123608001:1.male: Lately, many have lost their belongings at the Sunseek Arena. I suspect there's a thief, and I'd like you to look into it.
say:1:1123608001:1.female: Lately, many have lost their belongings at the Sunseek Arena. I suspect there's a thief, and I'd like you to look into it.

say:2:1123608002:1.text: One of our clansmen got his <style="highlight">pouch</style> stolen yesterday. According to him, there was a bounty hunter who seemed the most suspicious.
say:2:1123608002:1.source_cn: 昨天，黑嚎氏族里也有一位族人被偷走了<style=hi...

say:3:1123608003:1.text: That guy <style="highlight">wore a long cloak</style> and was always lingering around the counter at the betting house.
say:3:1123608003:1.source_cn: 那个人总是<style=highlight>披着一件长...

say:4:1123608004:1.text: You can ask the <style="highlight">owner</style> of the betting house. He's got a sharp memory, so I'm sure he knows something.
say:4:1123608004:1.male: You can ask the <style="highlight">owner</style> of the betting house. He's got a sharp memory, so I'm sure he knows something.
say:4:1123608004:1.female: You can ask the <style="highlight">owner</style> of the betting house. He's got a sharp memory, so I'm sure he knows something.

say:1:1123609001:1.text: You looking for a bounty hunter who wears a long cloak? Ha! No problem.
say:1:1123609001:1.source_cn: 想打听一个披着长披风的赏金猎人……？哈，好说好说！
say:1:1123609001:1.male: You looking for a bounty hunter who wears a long cloak? Ha! No problem.
say:1:1123609001:1.female: You looking for a bounty hunter who wears a long cloak? Ha! No problem.

say:2:1123609002:1.text: Information about some small-time bounty hunter isn't worth that much, but I still gotta play a round with you...
say:2:1123609002:1.source_cn: 一个名不见经传的赏金猎人，他的情报不值一赌，但我还是得...

say:3:1123609003:1.text: Let's play Century Quest and see who comes out on top! Will it be me or you, oh mighty mage?
say:3:1123609003:1.source_cn: 眼光锐利的押注老手，对战，称霸武斗场的魔法师！用百物牌...
say:3:1123609003:1.male: Let's play Century Quest and see who comes out on top! Will it be me or you, oh mighty mage?
say:3:1123609003:1.female: Let's play Century Quest and see who comes out on top! Will it be me or you, oh mighty mage?

say:0:1123610001:0.text: You've won this round. That bounty hunter you're asking about is called <style="highlight">Maverick</style>.
say:0:1123610001:0.source_cn: 这一局真是让我输得心服口服。您打听的那个赏金猎人，名叫...
say:0:1123610001:0.male: You've won this round. That bounty hunter you're asking about is called <style="highlight">Maverick</style>.
say:0:1123610001:0.female: You've won this round. That bounty hunter you're asking about is called <style="highlight">Maverick</style>.

say:1:1123610002:0.text: He should be hanging around the oasis to the west.
say:1:1123610002:0.source_cn: 这个时间，他应该待在西边的绿洲里。

say:0:1123611001:0.text: ... Who you looking at?! I don't know you!
say:0:1123611001:0.male: ... Who you looking at?! I don't know you!
say:0:1123611001:0.female: ... Who you looking at?! I don't know you!

say:1:1123611002:0.text: A bounty hunter wearing a long cloak... You're the one who stole the pouch!
say:1:1123611002:0.source_cn: 披着长披风的赏金猎人……没错！就是你偷了黑嚎的钱袋！

say:2:1123611003:0.text: How did you guys find out? Forget it... I don't have time for you dirtbags!
say:2:1123611003:0.source_cn: 你、你们是怎么发现的？！算了……我可没工夫陪你们闲聊！

say:0:1123612001:0.text: Stop hurting me! You can find everything in here! Be it the pouch or other stuff!
say:0:1123612001:0.source_cn: 别、别打了！不管你们要钱袋还是什么……都在这里！

say:1:1123612002:0.source_cn: 在这个背包里？那我们赶紧找找看吧！

say:0:1123613001:0.text: This pouch is covered in bear fur. It must belong to a Grimmaw clansman!
say:0:1123613001:0.source_cn: 这个钱袋上沾着好多熊毛，一看就是黑嚎氏族的东西！

say:1:1123613002:0.text: Let's hand it over to Kruger so that he can take it to its owner.
say:1:1123613002:0.source_cn: 我们赶快把它交给克鲁格，让他拿给失主吧！

say:1:1123614001:1.text: Thanks! You all are so reliable! You found the pouch so quickly!
say:1:1123614001:1.source_cn: 多谢。你们还是那样可靠，这么快就找回了钱袋。

say:2:1123614002:1.text: I'll give it back to its owner. Once again, allow me to thank you on his behalf.
say:2:1123614002:1.source_cn: 我会将它还给它的主人。请允许我替他再次向你们表达谢意。
